title: Testing startup recovery
notes: Restored the last known working R5 Atlas testing shell after the v0.5.0 hybrid integration caused startup problems on the web app and installed PWA.
Kept the Alberta Converter v2 offline lookup, history, maps, install support, settings, and managed update system from the working v0.4.0 build.
Hybrid live fallback changes are temporarily isolated from the testing shell until they pass full browser and installed app validation.
